intro: Flooring fitting covers laying a new floor surface, such as laminate, vinyl, or LVT, and repairing an existing timber floor, and FixWell Services carries out both across Salisbury and Wiltshire. Call +44 7391 599 078 or use the quote form for a free assessment.

sections.heading: What Flooring Work FixWell Carries Out in Salisbury
sections.body: FixWell fits laminate flooring using a click-lock floating installation over underlay, lays vinyl sheet or LVT (luxury vinyl tile) using either a click system or full-spread adhesive depending on the product, and repairs original timber floorboards that squeak, have split, or have gapped enough to let draughts through. Each method is matched to the flooring type: a floating laminate floor needs an expansion gap around the room's perimeter that a glued-down vinyl floor doesn't, and getting that detail wrong is what causes laminate to buckle within its first year.

sections.heading: Laminate and Vinyl/LVT Flooring
sections.body: Laminate flooring is rated by an AC (Abrasion Class) number, with AC3 suited to standard domestic rooms and AC4 or higher recommended for higher-traffic areas like a hallway. LVT carries a wear-layer thickness measured in millimetres, typically 0.3mm for lighter domestic use up to 0.7mm for busier rooms, and is available in a click-lock floating format or a fully bonded glue-down format. Both sit on a level subfloor, and FixWell checks that condition before quoting either option.

sections.heading: Original Floorboard Repair
sections.body: A squeaking floorboard is almost always a loose fixing to the joist beneath it rather than a fault with the board itself, and re-fixing it with a screw rather than the original nail resolves the squeak permanently. A split or damaged board is replaced individually rather than requiring the whole floor to be lifted. Gaps between boards wide enough to let draughts through are common in Salisbury's Victorian terraces, where floorboards laid over a century ago have shrunk slightly with age.

sections.heading: How FixWell Fits Flooring in Salisbury
sections.body: Every flooring job starts with checking the subfloor: is it level, is it concrete or timber, and does the existing floor covering need to come up first. Underlay is chosen for the flooring type, and adhesive is selected the same way for any glue-down product. Flooring is fitted with the correct expansion gap where the floor type needs one, then finished with trims and transition strips at doorways and thresholds.

sections.heading: Flooring Costs in Salisbury
sections.body: Laminate fitting costs £15–£25 per square metre for labour. Vinyl or LVT fitting costs £18–£30 per square metre, with the higher end applying to glue-down LVT, which takes longer to fit than a click system. Floorboard repair is priced per board or per room, depending on how many boards need attention. Removing existing flooring before a new floor goes down is quoted separately.

sections.heading: Is Your Subfloor Ready, or Does It Need Repair First?
sections.body: A level, sound subfloor is what most flooring jobs need before fitting starts, but Salisbury's older properties sometimes reveal a damaged joist or an uneven concrete screed once the old covering comes up. Where that's the case, the repair happens first and is covered under FixWell's home repairs service in Salisbury, with the flooring itself fitted once the subfloor is sound.

sections.heading: Floorboard Repair in Salisbury's Period Properties
sections.body: Original floorboards on a Victorian or Edwardian property are, in most cases, worth repairing rather than replacing wholesale. The timber is typically denser than modern equivalents and repairing individual boards keeps the floor's original character intact. This mirrors FixWell's approach to other original features on older Salisbury properties, covered in more depth in the guide to common home repair problems in older UK properties.

sections.heading: Flooring as Part of a Wider Renovation
sections.body: Flooring is often the final stage of a room renovation, fitted after walls, ceilings, and skirting are finished. Anyone planning a fuller project should read FixWell's renovation services page or the home renovation planning guide for Salisbury homeowners.

faqs.q: How much does laminate flooring fitting cost in Salisbury?
faqs.a: £15–£25 per square metre for labour. Room shape affects the figure: an irregular room with more cuts and edges costs more per square metre to fit than a simple rectangular room of the same size.

faqs.q: Can you fix a squeaky floorboard without lifting the whole floor?
faqs.a: Yes. The board is lifted just enough to access the joist beneath it, re-fixed with a screw rather than the original nail, and relaid, resolving the squeak without disturbing the rest of the floor.

faqs.q: Do you fit vinyl or LVT flooring?
faqs.a: Yes. Vinyl sheet is a single continuous roll suited to bathrooms and kitchens; LVT comes in individual planks or tiles and is fitted either as a click-lock floating floor or glued down for a more stable finish.

faqs.q: Do you need to remove my old flooring first?
faqs.a: Usually, yes, for a level, lasting result. This is quoted separately from the new flooring fitting since the condition of the subfloor underneath isn't always known until the old covering is lifted.

faqs.q: Can you sand and refinish original floorboards?
faqs.a: Minor repair to individual boards, yes. Full sanding and refinishing across a whole floor needs a drum sander and specialist finishing products, which is a job FixWell refers to a specialist flooring contractor.
